entries.title: Psalms 30:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm [and] Song [at] the dedication of the house of David.>> I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

words.text: ; for thou hast lifted me up
, and hast not made my foes

entries.title: Psalms 30:2
segments: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

words.text: unto thee, and thou hast healed

entries.title: Psalms 30:3
segments: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

words.text: , that I should not go down

entries.title: Psalms 30:4
segments: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness. {at...: or, to the memorial}

entries.title: Psalms 30:5
segments: For his anger [endureth but] a moment; in his favour [is] life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy [cometh] in the morning. {his anger...: Heb. there is but a moment in his anger} {for a night: Heb. in the evening} {joy: Heb. singing}

words.text: . {his anger...: Heb. there is but a moment in his anger} {for a night: Heb. in the evening} {joy: Heb. singing}

entries.title: Psalms 30:6
segments: ¶And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 30:7
segments: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, [and] I was troubled. {made...: Heb. settled strength for my mountain}

words.text: . {made...: Heb. settled strength for my mountain}

entries.title: Psalms 30:8
segments: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.

entries.title: Psalms 30:9
segments: What profit [is there] in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

entries.title: Psalms 30:10
segments: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.

entries.title: Psalms 30:11
segments: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

entries.title: Psalms 30:12
segments: To the end that [my] glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever. {my glory: that is, my tongue, or, my soul}

words.text: praise to thee, and not be silent
. {my glory: that is, my tongue, or, my soul}
